description.value:
You've designed a mine that explodes with healing medicine. You gain the following new mod.

  • Healing Mines (mine exocortex): Your mine uses tiny four-sided syringes full of concentrated medicine. Instead of dealing damage, your healing mine causes creatures to regain a number of Hit Points equal to the mine's number of damage dice. Unlike your usual mines, creatures in the area don't attempt a saving throw. At 8th level, add your Intelligence modifier to the number of Hit Points regained.

Special If you have the High-Tech Medic feat, you can apply any of the mods granted by that feat to your healing mines.
